items.note: Two preregistered experiments expose writers to biased AI autocomplete suggestions and measure post-task attitude shift; no creativity, quality, or diversity outcome on the writing is reported.
Designers ideate with ChatGPT-4 and DALL-E or with traditional sketch tools, and creativity scores are compared by independent-samples t-test; assignment and N not stated.

System paper (CHI 2026) with a within-subjects study (N=12) comparing InkIdeator with a baseline AI system lacking dimensional keywords; outcomes look like perceived ideation support, so it may be self-report only.

Studies generative AI's effect on design creativity with creative self-efficacy plus a modified Consensual Assessment Technique on products (AI raised effectiveness, lowered originality); comparison design and N not stated in the abstract.

45 industrial design undergraduates 'divided into' no tool, Pinterest search, or Midjourney conditions, with 10 experts rating outputs on originality, effectiveness, usability, feasibility; the abstract does not say random (a search note claims random assignment); below 50.

Conference abstract: multi-wave field study in two companies plus an online experiment on whether personal-life AI-assisted creating raises workplace creativity; the manipulation and creativity measure (possibly self- or supervisor-rated) are unclear.

Mixed-design experiment (N=905) with human or hybrid triads containing an undisclosed supportive or contrarian AI teammate across analytical, creative, and ethical tasks; outcomes are psychological safety and discussion quality, not creativity of the output, so the next stage may want to check the full text for task-output scores.

UIST 2023 system paper (XCreation, generative AI for picture-book creation) with a between-subject user study reporting higher creativity, controllability, and usability than the comparison condition; the comparison condition, N, and whether creativity is rated or self-reported are not stated.

Master's thesis (UvA): 40 participants (20 pairs) write stories alone, with a human partner, and with GPT-5.1; human-human stories are more semantically diverse and surprising; abstract text only from a web-search snippet of the event page, which now returns 404, so the full text may be unavailable.

12 design master's students ideate with Midjourney or Pinterest as inspiration sources; think-aloud protocols and interviews analyze the process, and the claim of more unique solutions may not rest on a scored outcome.
